item.title: Gamesforum Digest 2026-08-14
item.description:
Webstore revenue is exploding across casino and midcore genres, Pokémon Go's 10th anniversary drove a historic monthly spike, and Love and Deepspace collapsed after a content backlash - underscoring both the upside of DTC channels and the fragility of live-service reputation management.

Sources (6):

  1. Data digest: Monopoly Go’s booming webstore, Pokémon Go spikes, Love and Deepspace revenue crashes, more (MobileGamer.biz)
  2. Cheat Code for LTV Growth: Why Rewarding Existing Players May Be Mobile Gaming’s Next Growth Lever (Gamesforum)
  3. Mobile Gaming’s Spend-to-Grow Model Is Evolving (Gamesforum)
  4. Apple proposes 15% US link-out fee as it seeks settlement talks with Epic Games (PocketGamer.biz)
  5. July 2026 mobile game charts: Pokémon Go on the move, HoYoverse’s comeback, and record results for Gossip Harbor (PocketGamer.biz)
  6. Mo Co is underperforming and will be rebooted (again) – but Supercell says killing it is “unlikely” (MobileGamer.biz)
